overview_description.description:
Percent&Co is a Dubai-based company that provides business setup, corporate services, and administrative support for entrepreneurs and companies looking to establish or expand their presence in the United Arab Emirates.
The company assists with company formation in mainland, free zone, and offshore jurisdictions, helping clients navigate licensing, regulatory requirements, and government procedures. Its services include trade license registration, visa processing, PRO services, bank account assistance, and other operational support needed to start and manage a business in the UAE.
